notes: Identity independently checked: title The Substitutability of Physical and Social Warmth in Daily Life, John A. Bargh and Idit Shalev, DOI 10.1037/a0023527 match the original reference. This is a primary research article text with methods, results, references and appendices, bearing the May 23, 2011 advance-online citation rather than the 2012 issue citation. No PDF was supplied. Supplied page locators for Studies 1a/1b differ from the advance-online printed pagination; study headings establish candidate sections. No replication source or reported-success field is assigned. Printed candidate pairs: frequency r=.48, p<.001 (two-tailed); duration r=.29, p<.05; temperature r=.26, p=.07; summary index r=.57, p=.0001. The source explicitly standardizes the three items before taking their mean for the summary index. The neutral description does not distinguish these outcomes, so no candidate is selected. Recruitment count 51 is not promoted to critical-test analytic N; no exclusions or final analytic sample statement is provided in this section. All assigned fields examined; null values reflect unresolved target correspondence, not absence of printed results. Unassigned fields are placeholders.
